import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        
        long bestNum = 0, bestDen = 1;
        long bestDiffNum = -1; // use -1 as sentinel
        
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long a = x * i / y;
            
            // candidate a
            long diffNum = Math.abs(x * i - a * y);
            if (bestDiffNum == -1 || diffNum * bestDen < bestDiffNum * i) {
                bestDiffNum = diffNum;
                bestNum = a;
                bestDen = i;
            }
            
            // candidate a+1
            a++;
            diffNum = Math.abs(x * i - a * y);
            if (bestDiffNum == -1 || diffNum * bestDen < bestDiffNum * i) {
                bestDiffNum = diffNum;
                bestNum = a;
                bestDen = i;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
    }
}
